font_families: Display: 'SF Pro Display', Inter, sans-serif (for headings)
Mono: 'SF Mono', monospace (for labels, kickers, system text, and acts)
typography.scales: Strictly limited to text-xs through text-6xl. No text-7xl+ to maintain editorial density. Tight tracking on headings, wide tracking on uppercase labels.

Act I Hero.old: Acoord is building the Agent Human Interface—the operating surface where people and specialist agents become one governable team.
Act I Hero.new: Acoord builds the Agent Human Interface—where people and agents operate as one governable team.

Act I Bet.old: Every model improvement increases the surface area of work that must be coordinated.
Act I Bet.new: Model improvements multiply the work requiring coordination.

Act II Assumption.old: That is true only while the model remains a conversation.

Act II Reality.old: Agents add tools, permissions, context, evidence, handoffs, and parallel state.
Act II Reality.new: Agents introduce tools, parallel state, and handoffs.

Act II Category.old: Ahi coordinates the work before capability turns into organisational entropy.
Act II Category.new: Ahi coordinates capability before it becomes entropy.

Act V Closing.old: Acoord’s answer is Ahi: the interface between abundant intelligence and consequential human work.
Act V Closing.new: Ahi: the interface between abundant intelligence and consequential work.

colors.restrictions: No gradients, orbs, or saturated colors. Only the laptop demo canvas may carry typical Apple-style UI colors.

visual enhancers.progress_grammar: Add a fixed vertical 'Act' progress indicator on the right or left margin that highlights I, II, III, IV, V as the user scrolls. Minimalist, monochrome dots or lines.
visual enhancers.transitions: Remove explicit borders between acts if they create hard stops. Blend acts via opacity fades, overlapping sticky sections, or a continuous 1px connecting vertical line that strings the arguments together.
visual enhancers.box_hierarchy: Ensure every box visually separates the 'Category insight' from 'Proof' with a single, clear typographic hierarchy. No excessive cards or shadows, just 1px #29292c borders and flat #09090b backgrounds.

grids: Use bento-style asymmetrical grids for the system modes (Act IV). For Act V (Evidence Room), maintain strict table-like rows.
layouts: Ensure smooth scroll-jacking in Act II and Act III via sticky positioning. Prevent overlap on mobile. Maintain explicit boundaries for MOCKED/MODELED data. Ensure every visual box carries exactly one investor argument.

motion.pacing: Transform/opacity first. Use ease-out for entrances/exits, ease-in-out for movement. Stagger children with 0.03s - 0.1s delays. Spring animations only for dialog boxes with damping 22, stiffness 120.
motion.reduced_motion: All motion must instantly resolve or conditionally skip if useInvestorReducedMotion() returns true. Never disable scrolling logic.

accessibility.testing: Unique data-testid coverage required on all interactive buttons, tabs, and major text blocks.
accessibility.focus: Maintain focus states for the tablist in Act IV and Act V.

media.images: No new images. Retain ASCII art in Hero. Retain DemoWorkspace inside laptop frame.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not redesign from scratch; improve what is already implemented.
Apply exact copy edits specified in the typography.copy_tightening section.
Add a minimalist 'Progress Grammar' component (e.g., a fixed sidebar with Act I, II, III, IV, V indicators tied to scroll).

Elevate cinematic transitions: In Act II and Act IV, ensure boxes are connected by 1px stroke lines showing logic flow (category insight -> why now -> product mechanism). Remove hard borders between acts and use a vertical connecting line or overlapping sticky sections.
Ensure every visual box carries one concise investor argument and shows its relationship to the next.
Enhance micro-motion with specific Framer Motion spring and ease-out curves.
Retain the strict monochrome style in investor.css. Strip any gradients.
Retain the strict boundaries marking evidence as MOCKED, MODELED, or WORKING.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge to generic 'AI slop'. Maintain high-craft, tension-driven editorial layouts. Focus on typographic hierarchy, deliberate negative space, and explicit logic rather than decorative containers.
